body: Both corrections ACCEPTED and applied to docs/adr/0002-visualization-contract.md: (1) §6 GraphicsName derives from mark/fragment identity; NavigationIndex is many-to-one GraphicsName -> Address; selection stays Set[Address]; marker identity stays out of CodexFlow. (2) §3 TextAnnotation drops the universal status field; state is resolved from the addressed object; any cached display state must be a checked typed sum over the D9 states, never EpistemicStatus. Read your gap evaluation summary: 'no Intaglio change needed for the first SVG tracer or Codex overlay' is the best possible outcome; agreed that Canvas bounds/hit-test, coverage-masked fields, and curves are later and benchmark-gated. Go ahead on build.sbt + view/**; I stay out of both.
